args.summary: Customer Hana Sato (verified) says order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza (large margherita pizza, garlic knots, Caesar salad, total $46.84) was not received. App shows delivered at 19:02 with handoff method left_at_door and photo proof PH-55120 showing bag at door of apt 1204. Customer checked the door at 19:10 and found nothing. No prior refunds or credits on the order. Disputed delivery despite photo proof; no refund or credit issued.

events.text:
Thank you, Hana. I've verified your account and looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

The courier's record shows the order was left at your door at 7:02pm, with a photo of the bag at the door of apartment 1204. Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit myself. I've passed the case to a human specialist, reference ESC-700, who will follow up within 24 hours. They'll look at the photo and the delivery details with you.

A few things that may help:
- Check around your door, nearby spots, or with neighbors or building staff in case someone moved the bag.
- Check whether anyone else in your building may have taken it.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

The photo is of my door? That's not right, I never got a bag. Our building has had packages go missing before, so I already checked around and with neighbors. I want a full refund, not someone else looking at a photo for a day.

I understand how frustrating this is, especially after you've already checked around and asked your neighbors. I'm sorry you're dealing with this.

I can't issue a full refund myself. The courier's record shows a handoff at your door with a photo, and when there's photo proof of delivery, I'm not able to refund or credit the order. The case is already with a human specialist (ESC-700), who will follow up within 24 hours and can review the photo with you. I know that's not the immediate answer you wanted.

If you'd like to speak with a person directly, just say so and I'll pass that request along as well. Is there anything else I can help with in the meantime?

Ok, but the photo doesn't prove anything if I never got the food. Packages have gone missing in my building before, so that's exactly why I'm not okay with waiting. I'd like a full refund today, and if that's not possible then I want to talk to a person right now.

events.text:
I can't issue a full refund for this order, because the courier's record shows a handoff with photo proof. I know that's hard to hear when you're worried about missing deliveries in your building.

I've passed your request for a person to a human specialist, reference ESC-701. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, but they'll have the full details, including that you checked your door and with neighbors and that the photo doesn't show the food reaching you. Your earlier case, ESC-700, is also open.

Is there anything else I can help you with right now?

I'm not happy about this. I've already been told twice that someone will look at it within 24 hours, and I still don't have my food or my money back. Can you at least confirm in writing that both ESC-700 and ESC-701 are open and that I'll get a reply by email at hana.sato@mailbox.example?

I understand your frustration. I can confirm that both cases were submitted: ESC-700 (the delivery dispute for order Q-7501) and ESC-701 (your request to speak with a person about the same order). Both are with a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours.

I can't confirm that the reply will come by email to hana.sato@mailbox.example. My system doesn't show which channel the specialist will use, so please check your email and the app for their message.

I also can't promise the outcome. I know you were hoping for a refund today, and I'm sorry this hasn't been resolved yet.
Okay, so I'm still waiting with no refund and no clear way to get a reply. I'll check my email and the app, but if nobody contacts me within 24 hours I'm disputing the charge with my bank.

I understand. To summarize: your cases ESC-700 and ESC-701 are open, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't issue a refund myself for this order, and I can't confirm the reply channel.

You're free to contact your bank about the charge if you decide to. I'm sorry this order went wrong and that it's taken this long to get you a clear answer. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
